preconditions.expression: head is None or isinstance(head, ListNode)
preconditions.description: The input head must be either None or a ListNode object.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node, ListNode) for node in [head] + [node.next for node in [head] if node is not None])
preconditions.description: All nodes in the linked list must be ListNode objects.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= node.val <= 10**6 for node in [head] + [node.next for node in [head] if node is not None])
preconditions.description: Each node's value must be between 1 and 10^6 (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: all(node.val <= node.next.val for node in [head] + [node.next for node in [head] if node is not None and node.next is not None])
preconditions.description: The linked list must be sorted in non-decreasing order.

postconditions.expression: return_value is None or isinstance(return_value, TreeNode)
postconditions.description: The function returns either None or a TreeNode object.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node, TreeNode) for node in [return_value] + [node.left for node in [return_value] if node is not None] + [node.right for node in [return_value] if node is not None])
postconditions.description: All nodes in the BST must be TreeNode objects.

postconditions.expression: all(node.val in [n.val for n in [head] + [n.next for n in [head] if n is not None]] for node in [return_value] + [node.left for node in [return_value] if node is not None] + [node.right for node in [return_value] if node is not None])
postconditions.description: The BST must contain exactly the same values as the input linked list.

postconditions.expression: all(node.val <= node.right.val if node.right is not None else True for node in [return_value] + [node.left for node in [return_value] if node is not None] + [node.right for node in [return_value] if node is not None])
postconditions.description: For every node in the BST, its value must be less than or equal to the value of its right child (if it exists).

postconditions.expression: all(node.val >= node.left.val if node.left is not None else True for node in [return_value] + [node.left for node in [return_value] if node is not None] + [node.right for node in [return_value] if node is not None])
postconditions.description: For every node in the BST, its value must be greater than or equal to the value of its left child (if it exists).

postconditions.expression: all(abs(len(left_subtree) - len(right_subtree)) <= 1 for node in [return_value] if node is not None for left_subtree in [get_subtree_size(node.left)] for right_subtree in [get_subtree_size(node.right)])
postconditions.description: The BST must be height-balanced, meaning the heights of the left and right subtrees of any node differ by at most 1.
